newsitem.title: GREECE: PAPADEMOS OPENS SECOND DAY OF ECONOMIST CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: PAPADEMOS OPENS SECOND DAY OF ECONOMIST CONFERENCE.

text.p: Bank of Greece Governor Lucas Papademos opens the second day of an Economist conference at the Athens Intercontinental hotel on Wednesday.

Other speakers include Athens Stock Exchange President Manolis Xanthakis, Deputy Foreign Minister Yannos Kranidiotis and Defence Minister Akis Tsochatzopoulos. Prime Minister Costas Simitis closes the conference with a speech at dinner.
-- 0900 Lucas Papademos, Governor of the Bank of Greece, on "Heading towards the ECU"

-- 0930 Roundtable on Greek banking with Constantine Georgoutsakos, Governor of the Commercial Bank of Greece, Christos Papathanasiou, Governor of the Agricultural Bank of Greece, Nikos Karamouzis, Deputy Governor of the National Bank of Greece, Nicholas Nanopoulos, Managing Director of Eurobank, Panayiotis Poulis, Managing Director of Xiosbank.

-- 1120 Roundtable on the Athens Stock exchange with bourse President Manolis Xanthakis, Stavros Thomadakis, Chairman of the Capital Markets Commission and John Markopoulos, Managing Director of Sigma Securities.
